name: classify_paper
description: Classify an arxiv paper into a domain, collection, and topics.

domain_index.description: Index into existing_domains list. Use -1 to propose a new domain.

proposed_new_domain.description: Empty unless domain_index == -1; otherwise the proposed new domain name.

proposed_new_domain_description.description: Empty unless domain_index == -1; otherwise a one-sentence description of the proposed domain (what it covers, not the specific paper). Stored alongside the domain row.

collection_index.description: Index of an existing collection within the chosen domain (as shown in the tree). Use -1 to propose a new collection.

proposed_new_collection.description: Empty unless collection_index == -1; otherwise the proposed new collection name.

proposed_new_collection_description.description: Empty unless collection_index == -1; otherwise a one-sentence description of the proposed collection (what family of work it groups, not the specific paper). Stored alongside the collection row.

topics.description: Short strings naming the paper's most salient topics.
